desc: When you drink this potion, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour. For the same duration, you are under the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplBless00000]{Bless} spell (no Concentration required).
This potion's blue liquid bubbles and steams as if boiling.
name: potion of heroism
